main_measure.name: mean 20-bar forward excess return over coin mean, active grid bars
main_measure.threshold: mean excess > 0 with t >= 2 (and top-half minus bottom-half > 0) to confirm; mean excess < 0 with t <= -2 to reject; at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess top half minus bottom half by forecast (median split)

decided_by: t lies strictly between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Situation read from regime == 'trending' with forecast > 0; grid at positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with only bars having a full 20-bar forward return inside the window; the coin's mean 20-bar return is the mean over all its grid bars in all windows; the median split puts forecasts above the median in the top half and those at or below it in the bottom half.
